hero.label: FAQ
hero.title: Questions to ask before booking a vehicle inspection
hero.subtitle: Concise answers about the service, price, travel, and outcome.

faq.q2: How long does the inspection take?
faq.a2: A full inspection usually takes about 1.5–2 hours. The exact time depends on the car's condition and whether a test drive is possible.
faq.a3: We travel to the vehicle anywhere in Lithuania. There is no travel fee in Kaunas or within 20 km of the Kaunas city boundary; any fee beyond that is agreed in advance.
faq.q4: What will I receive after the inspection?
faq.a4: A report with photos, documented defects, and a clear assessment of the vehicle's overall condition.
faq.q5: What if the car is in good condition?
faq.a5: You will have an independent view of its current condition and any minor work worth planning for.
faq.a6: Yes. You can observe and ask questions on site when the location's rules allow it.
faq.q7: Do you only inspect used cars?
faq.a7: The service is for vehicles being considered before purchase, including used, demonstrator, and lightly used cars.
faq.q8: How much does an inspection cost?
faq.a8: A full pre-purchase inspection is €100; computer diagnostics is €20. Any travel fee is agreed before the appointment is confirmed.
faq.a9: We do not negotiate for you, but documented defects give you a concrete basis for discussing the price.
faq.q10: How do I book an inspection?
faq.a10: Choose a service and an available time on the booking page, then provide the vehicle details. The appointment is valid once we confirm it by email.
faq.q11: What do you check in a full inspection?
faq.a11: Body and paint depth, engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, electronics, signs of mileage discrepancies, tyres, fluids, and interior features. We test drive the car when possible and safe.
faq.q15: What is the difference between a full inspection and diagnostics?
faq.a15: Computer diagnostics covers control-unit faults and key parameters. A full inspection also covers the body, mechanical components, a test drive, and a photo report.
